voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In March nineteen-oh-six, in the coalfield of northern France, something ignited far underground.
One thousand and ninety-nine miners were killed. It remains Europe's worst mining disaster, one hundred twenty years later.
Within days, the company sealed the mine.
Twenty days later, thirteen men walked out.
No one — not the company, not its engineers — was ever found responsible. Not for the disaster. Not for the sealing.
